name: @scenesystems/digest
description: Cryptographic content hashing and canonicalization for Effect

scripts.lint: cd ../.. && oxlint packages/digest && eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/ --max-warnings=0 packages/digest && dprint check "packages/digest/**"
scripts.lint:fix: cd ../.. && oxlint --fix packages/digest && eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/ --max-warnings=0 --fix packages/digest && dprint fmt "packages/digest/**"
scripts.fixtures:verify: bun run fixtures:check && vitest run --root ../.. packages/digest/test/CanonicalJson/conformance.test.ts packages/digest/test/Digest/conformance.test.ts packages/digest/test/Blake3.test.ts packages/digest/test/Hmac.test.ts packages/digest/test/Hkdf.test.ts
scripts.build: bun run build-esm && bun run build-annotate && bun run build-cjs && build-utils pack-v3
